l1_connect_account.title: Turn on traffic visibility where nobody sees east-west traffic
l1_connect_account.why: Machines talk to each other in these environments, but nobody sees which talk to which, so nothing can be limited and an attacker moves freely.
steps: List the environments and the network segments in each.
Turn on traffic visibility for each, without enforcing anything.
Confirm the flows between machines show for each environment.
l1_connect_account.success: Every environment in scope shows its east-west traffic.
